summary: Find the largest subset of n integers in which equal sums always have equally many terms. Is its size Θ((n log n)^{1/3})?
problem: Let h(n) be maximal such that if A ⊆ ℤ with |A| = n then there is B ⊆ A with |B| ≥ h(n) such that if a₁ + ⋯ + aᵣ = b₁ + ⋯ + bₛ with aᵢ, bᵢ ∈ B then r = s.
title: Erdős Problem #789
